body:
Migrated from docs/agent-memory/bugs.md (entry dated 2026-09-22).

`Makefile:21` lists `ledger/go-test` in `.PHONY`, and the only `ledger/go-test` recipe lives on the ledger-on branch of the `ifeq ($(CORVINT_GATE_LEDGER),off)` block (`Makefile:51-60`). GNU make does not search pattern rules for a phony target, so with the ledger off `ledger/go-test` matches no rule and make reports `Nothing to be done for 'ledger/go-test'` — the whole-tree `go test -p 1 -timeout 30m -count=1 ./...` step is dropped while `gate` still exits 0. Reproduce: `env CORVINT_GATE_LEDGER=off make -n ledger/go-test`. Only the ledger-off path is affected — the default ledger path runs the suite through its own partition. Observed at `main` (cd9fec9) and at 82a113a; it voided the 0.6.0 candidate's recorded full-gate receipt, which passed in 4m13s without running any Go test. Done looks like: `ledger/go-test` reachable on both branches (drop it from `.PHONY` or give the off branch its own recipe) plus a regression asserting the ledger-off gate command list contains `go test ... ./...`, and no gate step that can resolve to "nothing to be done" without the receipt saying so.

completion.reason: Fixed on the release lineage by a033210 (tagged v0.6.0): restored the ledger-off gate and realigned the spec index.

title: gate: `CORVINT_GATE_LEDGER=off make gate` silently skips `go test ./...`
